div.p: CQL scoring library for PROMIS-29 Profile v2.1: raw scores and T-scores of the seven domains plus the pain intensity item. Server channel of the dual-channel scoring architecture (the FHIRPath calculatedExpressions in the Questionnaire are the client channel); both channels are generated from the same weight and T-score tables. Define names equal the score item linkIds. Supports Library/$evaluate with an explicit Response parameter and the SDC retrieve pattern (most recent completed QuestionnaireResponse of the instrument).
